what: the day's ranked clusters, in the desk's own one line, sources counted and linked (Jack, 5 October 2026)
what_a_wire_line_is: Each line is the desk's own one-line summary of a story it ranked, with its sources counted and linked. It is not a story the desk wrote or checked; only the item with a badge was checked.

items.line: Swiss regulator FINMA approved the country's first retail bitcoin ETF holding bitcoin directly, with custody safeguards and volatility warnings required.
titles: FINMA Approves First Swiss Retail Bitcoin ETF
Swiss regulator FINMA approves country’s first spot bitcoin ETF for retail investors
Swiss Regulator Approves First Retail Fund That Holds Bitcoin Directly
Swiss Financial Regulator Gives Green Light to Country’s First Bitcoin ETF
FINMA approves Switzerland’s first Bitcoin ETF for retail investors

items.line: France's National Assembly voted 38-37 to impose 31% capital-gains tax on stablecoin conversions starting January 2027, removing tax deferral.
titles: France's parliament approves vote to hit stablecoin trades with 31% capital gains tax

items.line: Kazakhstan court banned Coinbase, BingX, OKX, Bybit, Huobi, and Gate.io from unlicensed crypto services in the Astana International Financial Centre.
titles: Kazakhstan court bars Coinbase, five others from unlicensed crypto services in Astana International Financial Centre

items.line: US bitcoin ETFs drew $526.7M on Oct. 20, their biggest day in a month; BlackRock's IBIT accounted for all inflows while Fidelity and Grayscale saw outflows.
titles: Bitcoin ETFs just saw their biggest day in a month thanks entirely to BlackRock

items.line: Drift exploit wallet moved $61M in stolen ETH to Tornado Cash on Oct. 20, leaving $194M in remaining exploit funds and recovery claims unresolved.
titles: Drift-Linked Wallet Sends $54.8 Million in ETH to Tornado Cash
Wallet Linked to Drift Exploit Sends $61 Million in Ethereum to Tornado Cash
Drift exploiter sends $61M ETH to Tornado Cash, holds $194M

items.line: Ethereum staking hit record 43.8M ETH (36% of supply) in Q3 as yields fell to 2.63%; Solana staking also reached record 440.5M SOL.
titles: Ethereum staking hits record as yields fall and Solana activity grows: Bitwise
Ethereum Staking Hits Record 43.8 Million ETH, Bitwise Says

checked.says: Decrypt reports FINMA approved the country's first retail fund investing directly in Bitcoin as an ETF, waiving diversification rules for the product.
checked.unconfirmed: The specific asset manager or bank that will debut the product was not disclosed in the sources read.
